title: 004 种子与赛博鬼怪-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “使用。”

    晏梨沉声回答。

    “请将种子种进血肉之中，在脑海中描述出所需物品详尽结构图，倒计时1分钟。”

    机械音毫无感情起伏的播报着。

    晏梨眸光一动，这颗种子，便是她从文森特的血肉里剜出来的。

    她想着走到桌边抽出了笔筒里的美工刀，毫不犹豫地割开了自己的右手手掌心，将那颗五彩斑斓的黑色金属种子塞进了伤口里，脑海中快速的闪过画面。

    突然之间她的手腕一个翻转，抬手对准了身后的墙壁。

    那鲜血淋漓的右手心中，凭空多出了一把黑色上带着银色蒲公英纹路的消音手枪。

    晏梨手指勾动扳机，墙面瞬间出现了一个破洞，噼里啪啦的闪着火花，金属电线丝冒了出来。

    凄厉的叫声响起，房间像是电压不稳一般，光线闪了闪。

    紧接着在那破洞上浮现出了一张黑色的狰狞的人脸，那人脸扭曲着，眼珠子像是要凸出来一般，三百六十度的旋转，紧接着便又恢复了原样，恶狠狠地盯着晏梨看。

    “我先前的感觉果然没有错，有人窥视着我，并且可以在这个屋中自由的游动。”

    她说着，顿了顿，“你是什么东西？是鬼还是人？不能说话只能惨叫吗？我再试试！”

    那黑色的人脸扭曲了一下，一闪又藏进了墙体里不见了。

    晏梨屏住了呼吸，她看了一眼自己手中的枪，整个人都兴奋了起来。

    那特殊的种子，竟然当真可以随着她脑海里精细的构图而变幻成全金属武器。

    作为一个从小便被基地选中的武装人员，武器就是她肢体的延伸，是她灵魂的一部分。

    1分钟，足够她大显身手。

    晏梨想着，突然身体一侧，猛地转身朝着书桌前的玻璃窗就是一枪，又是一声惨叫响起，黑色的人脸扭曲成一团显现在玻璃上，紧接着又隐身不见了。

    玻璃窗电火花四溅，像是手机屏幕一般，碎裂了开来。

    晏梨沉思片刻，朝着窗外对面那群赛博朋克风十足的大楼显示屏看了过去，这一回播放的广告是打印机。

    银白色的打印机一看便是家中黑色老款的迭代版本，几乎是顷刻之间便打印出了五个风格迥异又个个盛世美颜的少年，开始跳起了练习时长八百年都不会有的刀群舞。

    “躲猫猫吗？这个我很擅长。”

    她是真的很擅长海里捞针的找到任务目标，然后抹杀掉。

    屋子里的光线再一次闪了闪，像是信号不好的老式屏幕，感觉随时都会冒出雪花点来。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Use."

Yan Li replied solemnly.

"Please plant the seeds into your flesh and blood, describe the detailed structural diagram of the required items in your mind, and count down for 1 minute."

The mechanical voice was broadcasting without emotion.

Yan Li’s eyes flashed. She dug out this seed from Vincent’s flesh and blood.

She walked to the table and took out the utility knife from the pen holder. Without hesitation, she cut open the palm of her right hand and stuffed the colorful black metal seed into the wound. Pictures flashed through her mind quickly.

Suddenly she flipped her wrist and raised her hand to aim at the wall behind her.

A black silenced pistol with silver dandelion patterns appeared out of thin air in the blood-soaked right hand.

Yan Li pulled the trigger with her finger, and a hole instantly appeared in the wall. Sparks crackled and metal wires came out.

A shrill scream sounded, and the room seemed to have unstable voltage, and the light flickered.

Immediately afterwards, a black and ferocious human face appeared on the hole. The human face was twisted, and the eyes seemed to bulge out. It rotated 360 degrees, and then returned to its original state, staring at Yan Li fiercely.

"My previous feeling was indeed correct. Someone was watching me and could swim freely in this room."

She said and paused, "What are you? Are you a ghost or a human? Can't you speak and can only scream? I'll try again!"

The black face twisted, then disappeared into the wall again.

Yan Li held her breath. She glanced at the gun in her hand and became excited.

That special seed can actually transform into a full-metal weapon according to the precise composition in her mind.

As an armed personnel selected by the base since she was a child, weapons are an extension of her limbs and a part of her soul.

1 minute is enough for her to show off her skills.

Yan Li was thinking about it, and suddenly turned around and fired a shot at the glass window in front of the desk. Another scream sounded, and the black face twisted into a ball and appeared on the glass, and then disappeared again.

Sparks flew out of the glass window, shattering like a mobile phone screen.

Yan Li pondered for a moment and looked at the group of cyberpunk-style building display screens opposite the window. This time the advertisement was for a printer.

The silver-white printer looked like an iterative version of the old black model at home. Almost instantly, five young men with different styles and prosperous faces were printed out, and they began to dance a sword dance that would not have been practiced for 800 years.

"Hide and seek? I'm very good at this."

She is really good at finding a needle in a haystack to find the mission target, and then obliterating it.

The light in the room flickered again, like an old-fashioned screen with poor signal, and it felt like snowflakes would appear at any time.
